description: This file contains unit tests for the OFBiz startup command utilities, validating command parsing behavior and argument validation.

classes.name: OfbizStartupUnitTests
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the command-line argument parsing and validation logic provided by StartupCommandUtil in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: commandParserDoesNotAcceptMoreThanOneCommand
methods.description: Tests that the command parser does not accept multiple commands when only one is allowed.

methods.name: commandParserDoesNotAcceptPortoffsetWithoutArgument
methods.description: Tests that the port offset option requires an argument.

methods.name: commandParserDoesNotAcceptPortoffsetWithoutPositiveInteger
methods.description: Ensures the port offset argument must be a positive integer.

methods.name: commandParserDoesNotAcceptArgumentForStatus
methods.description: Checks that passing an argument with the --status command is not accepted.

methods.name: commandParserDoesNotAcceptArgumentForStart
methods.description: Checks that passing an argument with the --start command is not accepted.

methods.name: commandParserDoesNotAcceptArgumentForShutdown
methods.description: Checks that passing an argument with the --shutdown command is not accepted.

methods.name: commandParserCombinesMultipleArgsIntoOneCommand
methods.description: Verifies that multiple command-line arguments are correctly combined into a single startup command with the appropriate number of properties.
